commands.name: mutation-red-without-reserve
commands.command: $path='src/order-service.ts'; $original=Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw; $mutated=$original -replace '\r?\n\s*await this\.inventoryService\.reserve\(request\.items\);',''; Set-Content -LiteralPath $path -Value $mutated -NoNewline; & node '${codeGraphRoot}\node_modules\tsx\dist\cli.mjs' --test 'src/order-service.test.ts'; $exit=$LASTEXITCODE; Set-Content -LiteralPath $path -Value $original -NoNewline; if ($exit -eq 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }
